name: Sparse2DGS
definition: A Gaussian Splatting method for surface reconstruction using sparse input views, initialized with MVS points and enhanced with geometric-prioritized schemes to prevent appearance overfitting and improve geometric learning under ill-posed conditions.
summary: Sparse2DGS is a Gaussian Splatting method for surface reconstruction from sparse views that initializes primitives with MVS points and fixes feature values to prevent appearance overfitting.
